# Spinner — sukuna-ui

> An indeterminate loading indicator (CSS spin).

- **Package:** `sukuna-ui` v0.5.0 — `bun add sukuna-ui` (or `npm i sukuna-ui`)
- **Import:** `import { Spinner } from 'sukuna-ui'`
- **Styles:** `@import "sukuna-ui/theme.css"` (Tailwind v4) or `import "sukuna-ui/styles.css"` (no Tailwind) — see [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/llms.txt)
- **Source:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/tree/main/src/components/spinner · **Spec:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/blob/main/docs/component-spinner.md

## Purpose

An indeterminate loading indicator (CSS spin).

## API

```ts
import type { ComponentPropsWithoutRef } from 'react'

export interface SpinnerProps extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'span'>, 'children'> {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'   // default 'md'
  label?: string              // accessible name, default 'Loading'
}
```

## Variants & tokens

Wrapper: `inline-flex text-accent` (crimson by default; override via `className`). SVG:
`animate-spin` + size sm `size-4` / md `size-5` / lg `size-6`; strokes use `currentColor`.

## States

Static; always spinning while mounted.

## Accessibility

- [ ] `role="status"` + `aria-label` announces loading; the SVG is `aria-hidden`.
- [ ] Motion is decorative; respect reduced-motion at the app level if needed.
